verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents several headless paths an agent could use. The Airbyte API controls Airbyte programmatically with access tokens and alongside orchestrators like Airflow. The Terraform provider manages configuration as code, PyAirbyte extracts and loads data from Python, and abctl is a CLI for standing up instances. Together these cover configuring and running pipelines without the UI. missing for 10: explicit evidence that a complete source→destination connection can be created and triggered end-to-end via API or CLI, headless connector scaffolding (Connector Builder and its AI Assistant are UI-only), a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven setup.
